title: Optic vesicle beside surface ectoderm
explanation: A forebrain-derived epithelial outgrowth approaches a distinct surface epithelial tissue.

title: Cup folding and lens invagination
explanation: Two connected developmental processes change tissue shape; the participating populations retain distinct ancestry.

title: Neural retina and RPE
explanation: The inner and outer cup layers differentiate; their opposed apical surfaces later face each other.

title: Retinal output and maturation
explanation: Ganglion-cell axons extend toward the brain while retinal cell classes and connections differentiate. The schematic does not assign a universal human age or claim completed vision.
